description: The shared configuration interface changes to a dictionary, but registered Qwen3MoeConfig still supplies a model class.
trigger: Construct a valid Qwen3MoeConfig and pass it to Model.from_config; alternatively call compile_model with that config and reach its Additional tensors block.
expected_behavior: Select Qwen3MoeModel as the text component and allow compilation to enumerate component hooks.
actual_behavior: Config stores Qwen3MoeModel as model_classes. The normal factory membership test raises TypeError rather than constructing the model; compilation's .items() raises AttributeError if reached independently. All inspected factory callers omit component, including conversion, examples and evaluation entry points. Ordinary conversion fails before reaching the compiler hook.

verification.description: Compared every parent configuration constructor and registry entry with the task diff, then inspected whole-tree factory callers.

Applied the new membership and .items() operations to a plain stand-in model class and to its text-component dictionary. The dictionary operations succeeded; the class operations raised TypeError and AttributeError.
verification.limits: Standard-library Python stand-in, not execution of Model.from_config or compile_model.
